# Runs Clean

> Engineering courses on the production layer of AI infrastructure. Verified against code that runs.

## Courses
- [MCP Production: Secure, Scalable MCP Servers in Python](https://runsclean.com/courses/mcp-production/): Model Context Protocol servers that survive retries, replicas, OAuth and gateways. Built on the 2026 spec, in 14 labs.

## Free guides
- [MCP 2026-07-28 migration: what breaks in a 2025-11-25 server](https://runsclean.com/mcp-2026-migration/): The MCP 2026-07-28 revision drops the handshake, sessions and server callbacks. What breaks in a 2025-11-25 server, what replaces it, and the error codes.
